description: IPS packages are the native packages in Solaris 11 and higher.

parameters.name: accept_licenses
parameters.description: Accept any licences. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: be_name
parameters.description: Creates a new boot environment with the given name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: An FRMI of the package(s) to be installed/removed/updated. Multiple packages may be specified, separated by ,.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Refresh publishers before execution. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether to install (present, latest), or remove (absent) a package. Choices: "absent" "latest" "present" ← (default) "installed" "removed" "uninstalled"

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.description: Set to true to disable quiet execution. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Install Vim
  community.general.pkg5:
    name: editor/vim

- name: Install Vim without refreshing publishers
  community.general.pkg5:
    name: editor/vim
    refresh: false

- name: Remove finger daemon
  community.general.pkg5:
    name: service/network/finger
    state: absent

- name: Install several packages at once
  community.general.pkg5:
    name:
      - /file/gnu-findutils
      - /text/gnu-grep
